input.text:
Fontaines D.C. have passed 1.6 billion Spotify streams, and lead single "Marianne" is already the band's #3 song by daily streams (327,696 a day). 🎸

The Dublin post-punk band's fifth album, Dopamine Chamber, arrived October 16 on XL Recordings with 11 tracks and the band's first-ever guest artist: ROSALÍA, on "Where Is Gone?". The song peaked at #3 in Ireland and #33 in the UK on Spotify's daily charts (Oct 13).

The numbers going in: 1,624,040,669 total streams across 85 tracks (kworb, Oct 14), about 3.28M streams a day, and 10.2M monthly listeners, up 151,811 in a single day on Oct 15. Their biggest song is still "I Love You" from 2024's Romance (211.7M streams, 559,401 a day), ahead of "Starburster" (187.9M) and "Favourite" (127.9M).

Critics were already warm before release day: albumoftheyear.org showed a critic score of 83 from 18 reviews on Oct 15. Grian Chatten has called the record a more corrupted, less hopeful counterpart to Romance.

Where does Dopamine Chamber rank for you: Dogrel, A Hero's Death, Skinty Fia, Romance or this one? 👇

Data: Spotify via kworb.net (Oct 14), Spotify monthly listeners (Oct 15), albumoftheyear.org critic score (Oct 15, 2026)
